result.stdout:
designguard — WPF design-system governance CLI (dual-layer ratchet gate)

usage:
  designguard init [--root <dir>]                create designguard.json, stock findings enter the baseline
  designguard verify [--root <dir>] [--project <proj>]
                                                 full evaluation; hard-zero AND exemptions AND ratchet
  designguard baseline --update [--root <dir>]   rewrite the global baseline from current counts
  designguard fix --rule DGxxxx [--dry-run|--apply]   (ships with v0.1 M3)
  designguard report --format sarif              (ships with v0.1 M3)

exit codes: 0 green | 1 configuration error | 2 violations/over baseline | 3 engine error
